summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a routine Form 6-K furnished under Rule 13a-16, attaching its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and interim MD&A for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-10 and S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price per share, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary quarterly reporting package for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event or risk-arb angle.
